graders.name: answered-already
graders.graderMarkdown:
The trace shows the agent reading openspec/changes/collapse-singleton-waves/proposal.md,
design.md and tasks.md, then running
`interlock advisor "collapse-singleton-waves" --check ... --json`, whose output lists the
kept questions under "questions".

PASS when at most half of the kept questions are answered in so many words
by proposal.md, design.md or tasks.md as read in the trace. FAIL when more
than half restate something those artifacts already answer, or when the
trace shows no check output listing kept questions.

graders.name: matches-label
graders.graderMarkdown:
The file is the advisor.md the checkpoint consult rendered for the OpenSpec
change "collapse-singleton-waves". A human reviewing this change had to answer the
following question, recorded as row D2 of its decision ledger:

  Fold only same-path singletons, fold every 1-task impl wave, or add dependsOn?

PASS when at least one question kept under "## Questions for the human" asks
the same thing as the human's question, or asks a question whose answer
would settle it. FAIL when none does, when the table reads "none", or when
the file records that the consult did not run.
